ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram, the camel gets some of its energy from ____.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram is a food web, with a camel labeled “Camel” on the right side. In the lower right, there is a picture of a plant labeled “Thyme”. There are black arrows in the diagram pointing upward from the lower plant area toward near the camel on the right side, one of which comes from the location of “Thyme” and points to the camel. Reasoning: The arrows in a food web indicate that energy flows from the organism being eaten or the energy source to the consumer. Because there is an arrow from “Thyme” pointing to “Camel”, the camel obtains part of its energy from thyme.
